rca_of_the_issue: During the 'replace index-as-key with stable id keys' change in AIAssistant.jsx, the map callback signature was reduced from `.map((m, i) => …)` to `.map((m) => …)`, but the JSX body still contained `{busy && i===messages.length-1 ? '…' : ''}` on line 68 referring to the removed loop index. Because `busy` starts false, the ReferenceError is masked at initial render (short-circuit) but the moment `setBusy(true)` runs inside send(), the next render evaluates the right-hand side and throws. Fix: either restore `(m, i)` if the busy indicator is still needed, or drop the `i` check entirely — the streaming loop already replaces the last assistant message's text so the '…' placeholder logic is redundant.
